mapper.insert: insert into study_post( study_id, member_id, post_type, title, content )values( #{studyId}, #{memberId}, #{postType}, #{studyPostDTO.title}, #{studyPostDTO.content} )
mapper.update: update study_post set title = #{studyPostDTO.title}, content = #{studyPostDTO.content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: select p.*, m.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id ) AS like_count from study_post p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id where p.post_id= #{postId}
